tools.name: post_create
tools.description: Create a post on LinkedIn with optional media attachment. Supports URNs for pre-uploaded media or local file paths for combined upload+post.

text.description: The text content of the post

draft.description: Save as draft instead of publishing (defaults to false)

images.description: Array of image URNs for multi-image post (minimum 2)

image_file.description: Path to a local image file to upload and attach

video_file.description: Path to a local video file to upload and attach

document_file.description: Path to a local document file to upload and attach

image_files.description: Array of local image file paths to upload and attach (minimum 2)

poll.description: Poll question text (creates a poll post)

poll_options.description: Array of poll answer options (minimum 2, maximum 4; required when poll is set)

poll_duration.description: How long the poll stays open (defaults to THREE_DAYS)

as_org.description: Post as an organization (numeric organization ID). The authenticated user must be an admin.

profile.description: Profile name to use from config file

tools.name: stats_post
tools.description: Get analytics for a single LinkedIn post (impressions, reach, reactions, comments, reshares). Requires the Community Management API product (r_member_postAnalytics scope).

aggregation.description: Aggregation mode (defaults to TOTAL). DAILY returns per-day breakdown.

from.description: Start date inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, lifetime stats are returned.

to.description: End date exclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, lifetime stats are returned.

profile.description: Profile name to use from config file

tools.name: stats_me
tools.description: Get aggregated analytics across all your LinkedIn posts (impressions, reach, reactions, comments, reshares). Requires the Community Management API product (r_member_postAnalytics scope).

aggregation.description: Aggregation mode (defaults to TOTAL). DAILY returns per-day breakdown.

from.description: Start date inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, lifetime totals are returned.

to.description: End date exclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, lifetime totals are returned.

profile.description: Profile name to use from config file

tools.name: stats_org
tools.description: Get share statistics for a LinkedIn organization. Returns lifetime aggregate statistics by default. When time_granularity and start/end are provided, returns time-bucketed statistics.

time_granularity.description: Time granularity for bucketed results (DAY or MONTH). Requires start and end.

start.description: Start of time range (ISO 8601 date, e.g. 2026-01-01). Requires end.

end.description: End of time range (ISO 8601 date, e.g. 2026-02-01). Requires start.

shares.description: Comma-separated share URNs to filter statistics for specific posts

profile.description: Profile name to use from config file

tools.name: document_upload
tools.description: Upload a document to LinkedIn (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, DOC, PPT; max 100 MB). Returns the document URN.

file.description: Absolute path to the document file

profile.description: Profile name to use from config file
